title: Area Assignment
description: Item-level stock targets for one zone without fixed places (myWMS ItemDataArea): how much of the item the zone should hold, regardless of which storage points it is on. Typically the result of a slotting or ABC analysis, written by a script; this repo does not compute it. The item-level min/max here wins over an area-level Topology-as-Code replenishment_strategy min/max for the same zone. Inside the zone, a fixed_bin_assignment of the same item governs its fixed places. Does not reserve or book anything at runtime.

item_id.description: References an item id in MasterData-as-Code.

uom.description: Unit of the quantities, a MasterData-as-Code uom id. Omit to use the item's default_uom.

min_qty.description: Replenishment into the zone is triggered when the item's total quantity in it falls below this.

max_qty.description: Replenishment fills the zone up to this quantity of the item; putaway into the zone stops above it.

planned_qty.description: Optional planned (target) quantity between min_qty and max_qty, e.g. from the slotting analysis.
